notes.title: Ocean Update and Settings Menu
notes.content:
Added water effects and models to the Ocean with seaweed, fish, and Seagull.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719920/9702c7fd5cb1c9d72892ceeee53368e1821f057a.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy the update!
